name: execution-budget
description: Preview task effort, authorization boundaries, and calibrated token ranges before an AI coding run.

interface.shortDescription: Plan task budgets and meaningful approval boundaries
interface.longDescription: Turn a coding request into a compact execution quote: heuristic or calibrated token ranges, time ranges, quick/standard/deep options, actions that may proceed autonomously, and the conditions that must pause for the user. It never claims exact whole-task usage and does not switch models automatically.
defaultPrompt: Estimate an execution budget and approval boundary for this task.
Compare quick, standard, and deep execution plans before starting.
Calibrate future task estimates from these outcome-labeled, caller-attested run records.
